newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Markets quiet, supplies tight.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Markets quiet, supplies tight.

text.p: Millfeed prices ranged from slightly lower to slightly higher across the U.S., but nearly all dealers reported light to non-existent late-week demand.

Millfeed prices were supported in many areas by tight nearby supplies, largely the result of flour mills cutting back operations to five days a week or less from a normal six. Dealers said a lack of export demand for flour prompted the production cutbacks.
Millfeed buyers appeared to have most of their immediate needs covered by purchases early this week.
Kansas City millfeed values edged higher in reaction to snow there since last Thursday, which may increase demand for feed, they said.
